findings.change_summary: Dormancy check per news-recency test. That places the project in the 2-4-year 'inferred shelved' band, not the <2-year 'stays proposed' band. Single non-primary source (business press quoting PNOC's president) -> yellow. Substatus tag for the inferred-shelved call: last confirmed project activity dated Jan 22 2024, ~2.5 years before this Jul 2026 check -- within the 2-4-year band.

qa_notes: Scope confirmed IN SCOPE: this is a genuine marine LNG import terminal, not a domestic-only virtual-pipeline/trucking plant. Per DOE/press description it is an LNG receiving terminal + regasification facility that takes marine LNG delivery via small LNG vessels/barges (ship-borne import), then distributes locally onward by truck/barge to industrial and power customers -- the ship-borne import leg satisfies the marine-crossing threshold; small-scale is fine per the methodology.
